simple_lenslet.analytic_model: square-aperture focal-plane sinc-squared intensity integrated over physical detector pixels

corrected_noisy_confirmation.wavefront_source: source ensemble run; identical physical coefficient vectors
corrected_noisy_confirmation.coupling: pair-local shared-minimum Poisson plus shared Gaussian read noise

acceptance.equivalence_margin_nm: min(0.5, 0.05 * supported-reference mean residual in nm)
acceptance.independent_unit: wavefront mean over five nested exposures
acceptance.mean_residual_rule: paired Student-t interval for mean residual difference lies wholly inside +/- equivalence margin
acceptance.mean_reconstruction_rule: upper Student-t interval for wavefront RMS of the five-exposure mean coefficient difference is <= equivalence margin
acceptance.stability_rule: both mean-residual and mean-reconstruction rules pass; noise variability is reported separately
acceptance.supersession: the prior all-grid-coupled framewise prediction-RMS decision is superseded because that estimand depended on unrelated grids
